dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single prominent, thick white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visual prominence with sharp boundaries between white edges and dark feather bodies on the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, distinct white patch of irregular rectangular shape is visible at the transition between the nape and the upper mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear demarcation between the black crown and greenish mantle, partially segmented by a white patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white auricular patch bordered by a black crown and throat region.
